title: Left/Right always switches tabs even while a custom-model or notify text input …
description:
Left/Right always switches tabs even while a custom-model or notify text input is focused (per AC5 and covered by a test), so arrow keys cannot move the text cursor within those fields. This is intended by the spec; consider suppressing TabBar navigation while a TextInput is active in a future iteration for smoother editing.

Source: cam/issue-87
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: 27d373b61e55

spec.scope: In the interactive config screen, suppress TabBar Left/Right navigation while a custom-model or notify TextInput is focused, so arrow keys move the text cursor within the field instead of switching tabs. Restore tab navigation when no TextInput is active.
acceptanceCriteria: While a custom-model or notify TextInput is focused, Left/Right arrow keys move the text cursor within the field and do NOT switch tabs.
When no TextInput is focused, Left/Right continue to switch tabs as before.
The prior AC5 test (asserting tabs always switch) is updated to reflect the new focused-input behavior; a test covers both focused and unfocused cases.
gotchas: The current always-switch behavior was intentional per CAM-87 AC5 and covered by a test; this issue deliberately overrides that decision, so update the test rather than work around it.
